description: Vu Dinh Quang and colleagues from Vietnam National University, the University of Tsukuba and University College Cork report an offshore-wind assessment for Vietnam. They select CCMP wind data, compare them with measurements, and calculate wind-energy density and capacity factors using an 8 MW reference turbine. Four coastal zones of 100 nautical miles width are assessed against existing power-source and port locations. The study identifies promising central and southern sea areas and reports a five-year Phu Quy capacity factor of 54.5%. These are resource and reference-turbine calculations for marine and power planning, not measured production from an installed 8 MW fleet. Zenodo supplies the article freely under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is Vietnamese offshore waters; exact calendar years and computational files are unspecified in the metadata. A limitation is that the article body and calculations were not inspected. No directly related catalogue record was established.
